text: In Genesis 22 the three days of travel have the character of a suspended sentence; to the outward eye nothing passes, while, in significance, all is passing. Faith here has the form of a structured relation, an arrangement, and is not primarily a matter of feeling. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with care; the instruments of the act are present before the act itself occurs. Obedience stands with horror, and neither is suffered to prevail.
